(8 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. The code change itself is small and behavior-preserving, but most of the patch is new documentation describing a normal/terminal visibility-class algebra that no code here (or anywhere in the tree) implements, and the framing overstates what the core now composes. Also carrying forward an unanswered question from patch set 3: should this be folded into the first patch of the series rather than landing code and then immediately rewriting it? Patch set 4 is a rebase only, so that question is still open.

commit.message:
LU-20290 lnet: refactor discovery visibility framework

Refactor the discovery visibility policy framework to separate policy
evaluation from visibility set composition.

Each visibility policy contributes one or more visibility sets, while
the core is responsible only for composing the sets produced by the
active policies. This establishes a generic framework for supporting
multiple independent visibility policies without changing the current
discovery behavior.

No functional changes.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity-lnet

Change-Id: Ic0d175d7a2f7dbfdfeb54a891f5bb816b92d6ee3
Signed-off-by: Serguei Smirnov <ssmirnov@thelustrecollective.com>
